scanNote: TEKSHIRILDI (skan 80-bet): matn so'zma-so'z solishtirildi. TUZATILDI - to'rtta gap tushib qolgan edi, qo'shildi: 'Then, Hans decided to return home.', 'Hans felt scared and started to run.', 'Hans knew what to do.' va 'I'm trying to stop the water... Can you help me?' iqtibosi. 17a 4 savol, qalin so'zlar 15 ta, 17c 8 voqea tartibi (d-f-c-a-h-e-b-g), 17d 5 tuzatish, 17e 8 prompt skan bilan mos.
audioRequiredUz: 17d — gaplarni tinglab tuzatish. Javoblar hikoya matnida ANIQ yozilgan, shuning uchun to'liq berildi.

sections.title: Reading & Listening — The Boy who Saved the Netherlands
sections.titleUz: O'qish va tinglash — Niderlandiyani qutqargan bola

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story: The Boy who Saved the Netherlands.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN:

  Many years ago in Haarlem, Holland, there lived a young
  boy. His name was Hans Brinker and he was eight years
  old. One AUTUMN day, Hans went across the canal to visit
  an old BLIND man. He took the man some biscuits and
  stayed there FOR A WHILE. Then, Hans decided to return
  home.

  "Be careful, Hans," said the old man. "The water in the
  canal usually gets higher in autumn." ON HIS WAY HOME,
  Hans sang a song, watched the RABBITS run around and
  picked some flowers for his mother. Suddenly, the sky got
  dark and heavy rain began to FALL. Hans felt scared and
  started to run. Just then, he heard the sound of water
  FLOWING away. He looked around carefully, then NOTICED a
  very small hole in the dike.

  Hans felt FRIGHTENED because he knew what could happen.
  The small hole could GET BIGGER AND BIGGER. Then, the
  dike could BURST and FLOOD Holland! Hans knew what to do.
  He put his finger in the hole, so no more water could
  come through it. "Please, someone help me!" Hans shouted.
  But there was no one there to help him. After a while, he
  began to feel very cold and tired, but he could not leave
  the dike. All night long, Hans waited and waited ...

  The next morning, a priest WALKED BY and heard Hans'
  CRIES. "I'm trying to stop the water," the boy said. "Can
  you help me?" The priest called some other people and
  they quickly mended the hole. Finally, they took Hans
  home. Everyone was very proud of that BRAVE little boy!


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:

  Ko'p yillar oldin Gollandiyaning Xarlem shahrida bir
  yosh bola yashardi. Uning ismi Hans Brinker edi va u
  sakkiz yoshda edi. Bir kuz kuni Hans keksa ko'r odamni
  ko'rgani kanalning narigi tomoniga bordi. U odamga bir
  oz pechenye olib bordi va u yerda birpas qoldi. So'ng
  Hans uyga qaytishga qaror qildi.

  "Ehtiyot bo'l, Hans," — dedi keksa odam. "Kuzda kanaldagi
  suv odatda ko'tariladi." Uyga qaytayotib Hans qo'shiq
  aytdi, quyonlarning yugurishini tomosha qildi va onasi
  uchun bir oz gul terdi. To'satdan osmon qorayib, kuchli
  yomg'ir yog'a boshladi. Hans qo'rqib ketdi va yugura
  boshladi. Shu payt u suvning oqib ketayotgan ovozini
  eshitdi. U ehtiyotkorlik bilan atrofga qaradi va to'g'onda
  juda kichkina teshikni payqadi.

  Hans qo'rqib ketdi, chunki nima bo'lishi mumkinligini
  bilardi. Kichkina teshik tobora kattalashib borishi
  mumkin edi. So'ng to'g'on yorilib, Gollandiyani suv
  bosishi mumkin edi! Hans nima qilish kerakligini bilardi.
  U barmog'ini teshikka tiqdi va shu bilan suv boshqa
  o'tolmadi. "Iltimos, kimdir menga yordam bersin!" — deb
  qichqirdi Hans. Lekin u yerda unga yordam beradigan hech
  kim yo'q edi. Birozdan keyin u juda sovqotib, charchay
  boshladi, lekin to'g'onni tashlab keta olmasdi. Tun bo'yi
  Hans kutdi va kutdi...

  Ertasi kuni ertalab bir ruhoniy o'sha yerdan o'tib
  ketayotib Hansning qichqiriqlarini eshitdi. "Men suvni
  to'xtatmoqchiman," — dedi bola. "Menga yordam bera
  olasizmi?" Ruhoniy boshqa odamlarni chaqirdi va ular
  tezda teshikni tuzatishdi. Nihoyat, ular Hansni uyiga
  olib borishdi. Hamma o'sha jasur kichkina bolani juda
  faxr bilan eslardi!


HIKOYA TUZILISHI (4 xatboshi):
  1  KIRISH  — qachon, qayerda, kim (77-betdagi qoida)
  2  BOShLANISh — uyga qaytish, yomg'ir, teshik topildi
  3  TUGUN   — xavf, barmoq teshikda, tun bo'yi kutish
  4  YEChIM  — ruhoniy, teshik tuzatildi, faxr

DIQQAT — 'THERE LIVED A YOUNG BOY':
  Odatdagi tartib: 'A young boy lived ...'
  Hikoyalarda esa: 'THERE LIVED a young boy ...'
  Bu — ertak va afsonalarga xos ADABIY tartib.

DIQQAT — 'HANS'' EGALIK APOSTROFI:
  Ism 's' bilan tugagani uchun apostrof OXIRGA qo'yiladi:
     Hans' cries = Hansning qichqiriqlari
  ('Hans's' shakli ham to'g'ri).

GOLLANDIYA VA TO'G'ONLAR:
  Niderlandiyaning katta qismi dengiz sathidan PAST.
  Mamlakatni suv bosishidan TO'G'ONLAR (dikes) himoya
  qiladi. Shuning uchun to'g'ondagi kichkina teshik ham
  butun mamlakat uchun xavfli.
  Bu hikoya — Gollandiyaning mashhur afsonasi.

points.en: Many years ago in Haarlem, Holland, there lived a young boy.
points.uz: Ko'p yillar oldin Gollandiyaning Xarlem shahrida bir yosh bola yashardi.
points.noteUz:
HIKOYA BOShLANIShI: QAChON + QAYERDA + KIM.
'THERE LIVED a boy' — ertaklarga xos ADABIY tartib
(odatdagisi: 'A boy lived').

points.en: His name was Hans Brinker and he was eight years old.
points.uz: Uning ismi Hans Brinker edi va u sakkiz yoshda edi.
points.noteUz:
17d-mashqning 1-bandi shu gapga asoslanadi:
'eighteen' emas, EIGHT.

points.en: One autumn day, Hans went across the canal to visit an old blind man.
points.uz: Bir kuz kuni Hans keksa ko'r odamni ko'rgani kanalning narigi tomoniga bordi.
points.noteUz:
'autumn' = kuz (amerikacha: fall).
'blind' = ko'r.
'ACROSS the canal' — 78-betdagi predlog.
17d-mashqning 2-bandi shu gapga asoslanadi.

points.en: He took the man some biscuits and stayed there for a while.
points.uz: U odamga bir oz pechenye olib bordi va u yerda birpas qoldi.
points.noteUz:
take → TOOK (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'a biscuit' = pechenye (amerikacha: a cookie).
'for a while' = birpas, bir muddat.

points.en: Then, Hans decided to return home.
points.uz: So'ng Hans uyga qaytishga qaror qildi.
points.noteUz:
'to decide to + fe'l' = ...ga qaror qilmoq.
'to return home' = uyga qaytmoq ('to' YO'Q).
17c mashqidagi f bandi shu gapga asoslanadi.

points.en: "Be careful, Hans," said the old man. "The water in the canal usually gets higher in autumn."
points.uz: "Ehtiyot bo'l, Hans," — dedi keksa odam. "Kuzda kanaldagi suv odatda ko'tariladi."
points.noteUz:
'Be careful!' = ehtiyot bo'l! (buyruq gap).
'get higher' = ko'tarilmoq.
Bu gap — hikoyadagi OGOHLANTIRISh.

points.en: On his way home, Hans sang a song, watched the rabbits run around and picked some flowers for his mother.
points.uz: Uyga qaytayotib Hans qo'shiq aytdi, quyonlarning yugurishini tomosha qildi va onasi uchun gul terdi.
points.noteUz:
'on his way home' = uyga qaytayotib.
sing → SANG (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'a rabbit' = quyon.
'to pick flowers' = gul termoq.
DIQQAT: 'watched the rabbits RUN' — 'watch somebody DO'
qolipida 'to' KERAK EMAS.

points.en: Suddenly, the sky got dark and heavy rain began to fall.
points.uz: To'satdan osmon qorayib, kuchli yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.
points.noteUz:
'Suddenly' — hikoyada BURILISh nuqtasi.
'get dark' = qorayimoq.
'heavy rain' = kuchli yomg'ir.
'to fall' bu yerda = yog'moq (yomg'ir haqida).

points.en: Hans felt scared and started to run.
points.uz: Hans qo‘rqib ketdi va yugura boshladi.
points.noteUz:
'to feel scared' = qo'rqmoq.
'to start to + fe'l' = ...ni boshlamoq.

points.en: Just then, he heard the sound of water flowing away.
points.uz: Shu payt u suvning oqib ketayotgan ovozini eshitdi.
points.noteUz:
'Just then' — 77-betdagi ketma-ketlik so'zi.
'to flow' = oqmoq.
'flow away' = oqib ketmoq.

points.en: He looked around carefully, then noticed a very small hole in the dike.
points.uz: U ehtiyotkorlik bilan atrofga qaradi va to'g'onda juda kichkina teshikni payqadi.
points.noteUz:
'carefully' — RAVISH (79-betdagi qoida).
'to notice' = payqamoq, sezmoq.
'a dike' = to'g'on (suvni to'suvchi devor).
17d-mashqning 3-bandi shu gapga asoslanadi:
'a big hole' emas, A VERY SMALL hole.

points.en: Hans felt frightened because he knew what could happen.
points.uz: Hans qo'rqib ketdi, chunki nima bo'lishi mumkinligini bilardi.
points.noteUz:
'frightened' = qo'rqib ketgan.
'because' — sabab bog'lovchisi (79-bet).
'what could happen' = nima bo'lishi mumkinligi.

points.en: The small hole could get bigger and bigger. Then, the dike could burst and flood Holland!
points.uz: Kichkina teshik tobora kattalashib borishi mumkin edi. So'ng to'g'on yorilib, Gollandiyani suv bosishi mumkin edi!
points.noteUz:
'get bigger AND bigger' = tobora kattalashmoq —
qiyosiy daraja IKKI marta takrorlanadi.
'to burst' = yorilmoq.
'to flood' = suv bosmoq.

points.en: Hans knew what to do.
points.uz: Hans nima qilish kerakligini bilardi.
points.noteUz: 'what to do' = nima qilish kerakligi - so'roq so'zi + to + fe'l.

points.en: He put his finger in the hole, so no more water could come through it.
points.uz: U barmog'ini teshikka tiqdi va shu bilan suv boshqa o'tolmadi.
points.noteUz:
put → PUT (shakli O'ZGARMAYDI).
'so' — NATIJA bog'lovchisi (79-bet).
'come THROUGH' = ichidan o'tmoq (78-betdagi predlog).
17b-mashqning A-rasm namunasi shu gap.

points.en: "Please, someone help me!" Hans shouted. But there was no one there to help him.
points.uz: "Iltimos, kimdir menga yordam bersin!" — deb qichqirdi Hans. Lekin u yerda unga yordam beradigan hech kim yo'q edi.
points.noteUz:
'someone' = kimdir;  'no one' = hech kim.
'there was no one' = hech kim yo'q edi.

points.en: After a while, he began to feel very cold and tired, but he could not leave the dike.
points.uz: Birozdan keyin u juda sovqotib, charchay boshladi, lekin to'g'onni tashlab keta olmasdi.
points.noteUz:
'after a while' = birozdan keyin.
'could not' = 'couldn't' (to'liq shakli — ta'kid uchun).
'to leave' = tashlab ketmoq.

points.en: All night long, Hans waited and waited ...
points.uz: Tun bo'yi Hans kutdi va kutdi...
points.noteUz:
'all night long' = tun bo'yi.
'waited AND waited' — takror uzoq vaqtni ta'kidlaydi.
17e-mashqning 6-savoli shu gapga asoslanadi.

points.en: The next morning, a priest walked by and heard Hans' cries.
points.uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab bir ruhoniy o'sha yerdan o'tib ketayotib Hansning qichqiriqlarini eshitdi.
points.noteUz:
'the next morning' = ertasi kuni ertalab.
'a priest' = ruhoniy.
'to walk by' = yonidan o'tib ketmoq.
DIQQAT: 'HANS'' — ism 's' bilan tugagani uchun
apostrof OXIRGA qo'yiladi.
17d-mashqning 4-bandi shu gapga asoslanadi.

points.en: "I'm trying to stop the water," the boy said. "Can you help me?"
points.uz: “Men suvni to‘xtatishga harakat qilyapman, — dedi bola. — Menga yordam bera olasizmi?”
points.noteUz:
'to try to + fe'l' = ...ga harakat qilmoq.
'Can you help me?' - yordam so'rash iborasi.

points.en: The priest called some other people and they quickly mended the hole.
points.uz: Ruhoniy boshqa odamlarni chaqirdi va ular tezda teshikni tuzatishdi.
points.noteUz:
'to mend' = tuzatmoq, ta'mirlamoq.
'quickly' — RAVISH.
17d-mashqning 5-bandi shu gapga asoslanadi:
ruhoniy EMAS, boshqa odamlar tuzatgan.

points.en: Finally, they took Hans home. Everyone was very proud of that brave little boy!
points.uz: Nihoyat, ular Hansni uyiga olib borishdi. Hamma o'sha jasur kichkina bolani juda faxr bilan eslardi!
points.noteUz:
'Finally' — ketma-ketlikning oxiri (77-bet).
'be proud OF' = ...dan faxrlanmoq.
'brave' = jasur.
HIKOYA TUGALLANMASI: nima bo'ldi + qanday his qilishdi
(79-betdagi qoida).

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. Which shows: a dike? a priest? a boy with his finger in a hole? people mending a hole?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang. Qaysi birida ko'rsatilgan: to'g'on? ruhoniy? teshikka barmog'ini tiqqan bola? teshikni tuzatayotgan odamlar?
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT RASM:

  A — Bola to'g'on yonida o'tiribdi, barmog'i teshikda.
      Orqada ko'prik va shamol tegirmoni ko'rinadi.

  B — Kattalashtirilgan doira: to'g'ondagi kichkina teshik
      va undan sizib chiqayotgan suv.

  C — Qizil libosdagi ruhoniy turibdi, bola unga
      qo'l ko'tarib murojaat qilyapti.

  D — Bir necha odam belkurak va chelak bilan teshikni
      tuzatishyapti. Ruhoniy va boshqa odamlar yonida.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a dike   = to'g'on (suvni to'suvchi devor)
  a priest = ruhoniy
  a hole   = teshik
  to mend  = tuzatmoq, ta'mirlamoq

items.textEn: a dike
items.answer: Pictures A and B (B is a close-up of the dike showing the hole)
items.whyUz:
TO'G'ON — sariq bloklardan qurilgan katta devor.
A-rasmda to'liq ko'rinadi, B-rasmda esa uning
kattalashtirilgan qismi (teshik bilan).
'a dike' = to'g'on — Gollandiyani dengizdan himoya qiladi.

items.textEn: a priest
items.answer: Picture C (and he is also in picture D)
items.whyUz:
RUHONIY — C-rasmda qizil libosda, ko'kragida xoch.
U D-rasmda ham bor (chap tomonda).
'a priest' = ruhoniy, cherkov xizmatchisi.

items.textEn: a boy with his finger in a hole
items.answer: Picture A
items.whyUz:
A-rasmda Hans to'g'on yonida o'tirib, barmog'ini
teshikka tiqib turibdi.
Matnda: 'He put his finger in the hole'.
Bu — hikoyaning eng mashhur sahnasi.

items.textEn: people mending a hole
items.answer: Picture D
items.whyUz:
D-rasmda bir necha odam belkurak va chelak bilan
teshikni tuzatishyapti.
Matnda: 'they quickly mended the hole'.
'to mend' = tuzatmoq, ta'mirlamoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story and explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani o'qing va qalin yozilgan so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N BESH QALIN SO'Z VA IBORA:
  autumn, blind, for a while, on his way home, rabbits,
  fall, flowing, noticed, frightened,
  get bigger and bigger, burst, flood, walked by,
  cries, brave

Ular matnda qalin harflar bilan berilgan —
ma'nosini kontekstdan topish kerak.

points.en: autumn
points.uz: kuz
points.noteUz:
'One AUTUMN day' = bir kuz kuni.
Britancha: autumn;  amerikacha: fall.
DIQQAT: 'fall' bu matnda BOShQA ma'noda ham bor —
'yog'moq'.

points.en: blind
points.uz: ko'r
points.noteUz:
'an old BLIND man' = keksa ko'r odam.
Ko'ra olmaydigan odam.
Shunga o'xshash: 'deaf' = kar (Grammar 44-betda).

points.en: for a while
points.uz: birpas, bir muddat
points.noteUz:
'stayed there FOR A WHILE' = u yerda birpas qoldi.
Matnda yana bor: 'AFTER A WHILE' = birozdan keyin.
Aniq vaqt emas, qisqa muddat.

points.en: on his way home
points.uz: uyga qaytayotib
points.noteUz:
'ON HIS WAY HOME, Hans sang a song' =
uyga qaytayotib Hans qo'shiq aytdi.
Shunga o'xshash: on my way to school, on her way to work.

points.en: rabbits
points.uz: quyonlar
points.noteUz:
'watched the RABBITS run around' =
quyonlarning yugurishini tomosha qildi.
'a rabbit' = quyon.

points.en: fall
points.uz: yog'moq (yomg'ir haqida)
points.noteUz:
'heavy rain began to FALL' = kuchli yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.
DIQQAT: 'fall' asosiy ma'nosi — YIQILMOQ
(78-betda: 'fell off the horse').
Bu yerda esa YOG'MOQ.
Amerikachada 'fall' = kuz ham.

points.en: flowing
points.uz: oqayotgan
points.noteUz:
'the sound of water FLOWING away' =
suvning oqib ketayotgan ovozi.
'to flow' = oqmoq (daryo, suv haqida).
'flow away' = oqib ketmoq.

points.en: noticed
points.uz: payqadi, sezdi
points.noteUz:
'NOTICED a very small hole' = juda kichkina teshikni payqadi.
'to notice' = ko'zga tashlanmoq, payqamoq.
DIQQAT: 'see' (ko'rmoq) dan farqi — 'notice' diqqat
qaratib SEZISHNI bildiradi.

points.en: frightened
points.uz: qo'rqib ketgan
points.noteUz:
'Hans felt FRIGHTENED' = Hans qo'rqib ketdi.
'to frighten' = qo'rqitmoq → 'frightened' = qo'rqqan.
76-betdagi 'scared' bilan bir xil ma'no.
DIQQAT: 'frightening' = qo'rqinchli (narsa haqida).

points.en: get bigger and bigger
points.uz: tobora kattalashmoq
points.noteUz:
'The small hole could GET BIGGER AND BIGGER.'
QIYOSIY daraja IKKI marta takrorlanadi —
bu asta-sekin o'zgarishni bildiradi.
Shunga o'xshash: hotter and hotter, worse and worse.

points.en: burst
points.uz: yorilmoq, portlamoq
points.noteUz:
'the dike could BURST' = to'g'on yorilishi mumkin edi.
Bosim ta'sirida to'satdan buzilish.
DIQQAT: burst → BURST (shakli O'ZGARMAYDI —
'cut', 'put' kabi).

points.en: flood
points.uz: suv bosmoq
points.noteUz:
'BURST and FLOOD Holland' = yorilib Gollandiyani
suv bosishi mumkin edi.
Ot sifatida: 'a flood' = toshqin, suv toshqini.
O'qilishi /flʌd/ ('flad').

points.en: walked by
points.uz: yonidan o'tib ketdi
points.noteUz:
'a priest WALKED BY' = bir ruhoniy o'sha yerdan o'tib ketdi.
'walk by' = yonidan o'tmoq (to'xtamasdan).
78-betdagi 'past' predlogiga o'xshash.

points.en: cries
points.uz: qichqiriqlar
points.noteUz:
'heard Hans' CRIES' = Hansning qichqiriqlarini eshitdi.
'a cry' = qichqiriq;  ko'pligi: cries (Y → IES).
Fe'l sifatida: 'to cry' = yig'lamoq; qichqirmoq.

points.en: brave
points.uz: jasur, botir
points.noteUz:
'that BRAVE little boy' = o'sha jasur kichkina bola.
'brave' = qo'rqmas, jasur.
Oti: 'bravery' = jasorat.
Hikoyaning ASOSIY g'oyasi shu so'zda.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, underline the sentences which best describe each picture.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng har bir rasmni eng yaxshi tasvirlaydigan gaplarning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Picture A — 'He put his finger in the hole, so no more
              water could come through it.'

USUL: har bir rasmdagi ASOSIY harakatni matndan toping.

items.textEn: Picture A
items.answer: He put his finger in the hole, so no more water could come through it.
items.whyUz:
A-rasmda bola barmog'ini teshikka tiqib o'tiribdi.
Matnning 3-xatboshisidan.

items.textEn: Picture B
items.answer: He looked around carefully, then noticed a very small hole in the dike.
items.whyUz:
B-rasm — to'g'ondagi KIChKINA TEShIKning
kattalashtirilgan ko'rinishi.
Matnning 2-xatboshi oxiridan.
DIQQAT: 17d-mashqning 3-bandi ham shu gapga asoslanadi —
teshik KIChKINA edi, katta emas.

items.textEn: Picture C
items.answer: The next morning, a priest walked by and heard Hans' cries.
items.whyUz:
C-rasmda ruhoniy turibdi, bola unga murojaat qilyapti.
Matnning 4-xatboshi boshidan.
Boshqa mumkin variant: "'I'm trying to stop the water,'
the boy said. 'Can you help me?'"

items.textEn: Picture D
items.answer: The priest called some other people and they quickly mended the hole.
items.whyUz:
D-rasmda odamlar teshikni tuzatishyapti.
Matnning 4-xatboshi o'rtasidan.
'to mend' = tuzatmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the events of the story below, then read the story again and put the events in the correct order.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi voqealarni o'qing, so'ng hikoyani yana o'qib voqealarni to'g'ri tartibga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ VOQEA — hikoyadagi tartibda joylashtiriladi.

Kitob 'd' ni '1' deb belgilagan.

TO'G'RI TARTIB:

  1  d  Hans Brinker went to visit an old blind man.
  2  f  Hans decided to return home.
  3  c  The sky got dark and rain began to fall.
  4  a  Hans heard the sound of water flowing away.
  5  h  Hans noticed a very small hole in the dike.
  6  e  Hans put his finger in the hole.
  7  b  A priest heard Hans' cries and called some people
        to help.
  8  g  The people mended the hole.

MATNDAGI KETMA-KETLIK:
  1-xatboshi: 'Hans WENT ACROSS THE CANAL TO VISIT an old
              blind man ... Then, Hans DECIDED TO RETURN HOME.'
  2-xatboshi: 'Suddenly, the SKY GOT DARK and heavy RAIN
              BEGAN TO FALL ... he HEARD THE SOUND OF WATER
              FLOWING away ... NOTICED a very small HOLE.'
  3-xatboshi: 'He PUT HIS FINGER IN THE HOLE ...'
  4-xatboshi: 'a priest ... HEARD HANS' CRIES ... The priest
              CALLED SOME OTHER PEOPLE and they quickly
              MENDED THE HOLE.'

So'ng bu tartibda hikoyani ketma-ketlik so'zlari bilan
so'zlab bering: first, then, after that, just then,
finally.

items.textEn: d  Hans Brinker went to visit an old blind man.
items.whyUz:
BIRINCHI voqea.
Matnda: 'Hans went across the canal to visit an old
blind man.'

items.textEn: f  Hans decided to return home.
items.whyUz:
IKKINCHI voqea.
Matnda: 'Then, Hans DECIDED TO RETURN HOME.'
1-xatboshining oxirgi gapi.

items.textEn: c  The sky got dark and rain began to fall.
items.whyUz:
UChINChI voqea.
Matnda: 'Suddenly, the sky got dark and heavy rain began
to fall.'
'Suddenly' — burilish nuqtasi.

items.textEn: a  Hans heard the sound of water flowing away.
items.whyUz:
TO'RTINChI voqea.
Matnda: 'Just then, he heard the sound of water flowing
away.'

items.textEn: h  Hans noticed a very small hole in the dike.
items.whyUz:
BEShINChI voqea.
Matnda: 'He looked around carefully, then noticed a very
small hole in the dike.'
B-rasmga mos keladi.

items.textEn: e  Hans put his finger in the hole.
items.whyUz:
OLTINChI voqea.
Matnda: 'He put his finger in the hole, so no more water
could come through it.'
A-rasmga mos keladi.

items.textEn: b  A priest heard Hans' cries and called some people to help.
items.whyUz:
YETTINChI voqea.
Matnda: 'The next morning, a priest walked by and heard
Hans' cries ... The priest called some other people.'
C-rasmga mos keladi.

items.textEn: g  The people mended the hole.
items.whyUz:
SAKKIZINChI voqea.
Matnda: 'they quickly mended the hole'.
D-rasmga mos keladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences, then listen and correct them.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglab ularni to'g'rilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  Hans Brinker was eighteen years old.   ...eight...
     Hans Brinker WASN'T eighteen years old. He WAS eight.

QOLIP (IKKI GAP):
  Ega + INKOR + noto'g'ri ma'lumot.
  Ega + TASDIQ + to'g'ri ma'lumot.

IKKI XIL INKOR:
  'BE' fe'li bilan → WASN'T ('didn't' KERAK EMAS)
  Boshqa fe'llar bilan → DIDN'T + ASOSIY shakl

JAVOBLAR HIKOYA MATNIDA ANIQ YOZILGAN.

items.textEn: 1  Hans Brinker was eighteen years old.
items.answer: Hans Brinker wasn't eighteen years old. He was eight.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'he was EIGHT years old'.
'be' fe'li → WASN'T ('didn't' KERAK EMAS).
DIQQAT: 'eight' (8) ↔ 'eighteen' (18) — bir harf farqi.

items.textEn: 2  Hans visited a young woman.
items.answer: Hans didn't visit a young woman. He visited an old blind man.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'to visit AN OLD BLIND MAN'.
'visit' — oddiy fe'l → DIDN'T + VISIT (asosiy shakl).
Tasdiqda 'VISITED' (o'tgan shakl).

items.textEn: 3  Hans saw a big hole in the dike.
items.answer: Hans didn't see a big hole in the dike. He saw a very small hole.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'noticed A VERY SMALL HOLE in the dike'.
Inkorda 'didn't SEE' (asosiy shakl),
tasdiqda 'SAW' (noto'g'ri fe'lning o'tgan shakli).
DIQQAT: teshikning KIChKINA bo'lishi muhim —
u asta-sekin kattalashishi mumkin edi.

items.textEn: 4  A woman heard Hans' cries.
items.answer: A woman didn't hear Hans' cries. A priest heard them.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'A PRIEST walked by and heard Hans' cries'.
Inkorda 'didn't HEAR' (asosiy shakl),
tasdiqda 'HEARD' (noto'g'ri fe'lning o'tgan shakli).

items.textEn: 5  A priest mended the hole.
items.answer: A priest didn't mend the hole. Some other people mended it.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'The priest CALLED some other people and THEY
quickly MENDED the hole'.
Ruhoniy CHAQIRDI, lekin BOShQA ODAMLAR tuzatdi.
Inkorda 'didn't MEND', tasdiqda 'MENDED'.

exercises.instructionEn: Work in pairs. Use the prompts to ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ishlang. Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Where / Hans / live?
  SA: Where DID Hans LIVE?
  SB: He LIVED in Haarlem, Holland.

QOLIP:
  SA: [savol so'zi] + DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l + ...?
  SB: [ega] + O'TGAN fe'l + ... .

DIQQAT — 1-BAND BOShQACHA:
  'How old / BE / Hans?' — 'be' fe'li →
  'How old WAS Hans?' ('did' KERAK EMAS).

Qolgan barcha bandlarda 'did' KERAK.

Bir dialogda IKKI xil shakl:
  savolda ASOSIY, javobda O'TGAN.

items.question: Where did Hans live?
items.answer: He lived in Haarlem, Holland.
items.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
Savolda 'LIVE' (asosiy), javobda 'LIVED' (o'tgan).

items.question: How old was Hans?
items.answer: He was eight years old.
items.whyUz:
DIQQAT — BU BAND BOShQACHA:
'be' fe'li → 'How old WAS Hans?'
'did' KERAK EMAS.
Matnda: 'he was EIGHT years old'.

items.question: Who did Hans visit?
items.answer: He visited an old blind man.
items.whyUz:
'who' bu yerda TO'LDIRUVChI (kimni?) → 'did' KERAK.
Savolda 'VISIT', javobda 'VISITED'.

items.question: What did Hans take the man?
items.answer: He took him some biscuits.
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'TAKE' (asosiy), javobda 'TOOK' (o'tgan).
'take somebody something' = kimgadir nimadir olib bormoq.
'a biscuit' = pechenye.

items.question: What did Hans hear?
items.answer: He heard the sound of water flowing away.
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'HEAR' (asosiy), javobda 'HEARD' (o'tgan).
DIQQAT: 'did he heard' XATO.

items.question: What did Hans notice?
items.answer: He noticed a very small hole in the dike.
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'NOTICE', javobda 'NOTICED'.
'to notice' = payqamoq.

items.question: How long did Hans stay there?
items.answer: He stayed there all night long.
items.whyUz:
'How long ...?' = qancha vaqt?
Matnda: 'ALL NIGHT LONG, Hans waited and waited'.
Savolda 'STAY', javobda 'STAYED'.

items.question: Who did the priest call?
items.answer: He called some other people.
items.whyUz:
'who' TO'LDIRUVChI → 'did' KERAK.
Savolda 'CALL', javobda 'CALLED'.

items.question: What did the people do?
items.answer: They quickly mended the hole and took Hans home.
items.whyUz:
DIQQAT: 'do' fe'li IKKI marta —
'did' (yordamchi) + 'do' (asosiy).
'What did the people DO?' — to'g'ri qolip.
Javobda ikki harakat: tuzatishdi va uyiga olib borishdi.

wordFormation.introUz: 80-bet — tabiat va xavf lug'ati, his-tuyg'u, egalik apostrofi.

patterns.formula: MANY YEARS AGO IN + joy, THERE LIVED + ega.
patterns.exampleEn: Many years ago in Haarlem, Holland, there lived a young boy.
patterns.exampleUz: Ko'p yillar oldin Gollandiyaning Xarlem shahrida bir yosh bola yashardi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'THERE LIVED ...' — ertak va afsonalarga xos ADABIY tartib.
Odatdagisi: 'A young boy lived ...'

patterns.formula: Ega + FELT + his-tuyg'u sifati + BECAUSE + sabab.
patterns.exampleEn: Hans felt frightened because he knew what could happen.
patterns.exampleUz: Hans qo'rqib ketdi, chunki nima bo'lishi mumkinligini bilardi.

patterns.exampleEn: He put his finger in the hole, so no more water could come through it.
patterns.exampleUz: U barmog'ini teshikka tiqdi, shu bilan suv boshqa o'tolmadi.

patterns.formula: Ega + COULD GET + qiyosiy daraja + AND + qiyosiy daraja.
patterns.exampleEn: The small hole could get bigger and bigger.
patterns.exampleUz: Kichkina teshik tobora kattalashib borishi mumkin edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Qiyosiy daraja IKKI marta takrorlanadi —
asta-sekin o'zgarishni bildiradi.

patterns.formula: [savol so'zi] + DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?   →   ega + O'TGAN fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Where did Hans live? — He lived in Haarlem, Holland.
patterns.exampleUz: Hans qayerda yashardi? — U Gollandiyaning Xarlem shahrida yashardi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Savolda ASOSIY shakl, javobda O'TGAN shakl.
LEKIN 'be' fe'li bilan: 'How old WAS Hans?' ('did' yo'q).

patterns.formula: Everyone WAS very PROUD OF + kim.
patterns.exampleEn: Everyone was very proud of that brave little boy!
patterns.exampleUz: Hamma o'sha jasur kichkina bolani juda faxr bilan eslardi!
patterns.explanationUz:
'proud OF' — 'of' SHART.
Hikoya tugallanmasi: his-tuyg'u bilan tugaydi (79-bet).
